nodes.label: Voucher Cards Sprite Atlas
nodes.description: Sprite atlas containing all Voucher card artwork for Balatro. 4 rows x 8 columns grid, ~32 voucher sprites plus placeholder/locked slots.

nodes.label: Overstock Voucher
nodes.description: Red voucher card with a plus/cross icon. Overstock — grants an extra card slot in the shop.

nodes.label: Clearance Sale Voucher
nodes.description: Gold/orange voucher card with an upward arrow. Clearance Sale — reduces prices of items in the shop.

nodes.label: Hone Voucher
nodes.description: Blue voucher card with an upward arrow. Hone — foil playing cards appear more frequently.

nodes.label: Reroll Surplus Voucher
nodes.description: Teal voucher card with dollar-sign and arrows icon. Reroll Surplus — reduces the cost of rerolling the shop.

nodes.label: Crystal Ball Voucher
nodes.description: Blue voucher card with a person/upgrade icon. Crystal Ball — grants an extra consumable slot.

nodes.label: Grabber Voucher
nodes.description: Blue voucher card with a hand icon. Grabber — grants one extra hand per round.

nodes.label: Wasteful Voucher
nodes.description: Red voucher card with a trash can icon. Wasteful — grants one extra discard per round.

nodes.label: Overstock Plus Voucher
nodes.description: Orange voucher with chaotic/tendrils icon. Overstock Plus — upgraded version of Overstock granting additional card slots.

nodes.label: Liquidation Voucher
nodes.description: Gold voucher with multiple arrows icon. Liquidation — upgraded Clearance Sale giving further price reductions.

nodes.label: Glow Up Voucher
nodes.description: Blue voucher with double tall arrows. Glow Up — upgraded Hone, foil/holographic/polychrome cards appear more frequently.

nodes.label: Reroll Glut Voucher
nodes.description: Teal voucher with multiple figures/upgrade icons. Reroll Glut — upgraded Reroll Surplus with further reroll cost reduction.

nodes.label: Omen Globe Voucher
nodes.description: Colorful voucher with clown and globe figures. Omen Globe — spectral cards can appear in the shop.

nodes.label: Nacho Tong Voucher
nodes.description: Orange/fire voucher with tentacles icon. Nacho Tong — upgraded Grabber granting additional hands per round.

nodes.label: Recyclomancy Voucher
nodes.description: Teal voucher with cauldron icon. Recyclomancy — upgraded Wasteful granting additional discards per round.

nodes.label: Hieroglyph Voucher
nodes.description: Purple voucher with ghost/tentacles icon. Hieroglyph — each Ante, hand size increases by 1 but hands per round decreases by 1.

nodes.label: Telescope Voucher
nodes.description: Teal voucher with circular arrows/recycling icon. Telescope — most used planet card appears in the shop.

nodes.label: Planet Merchant Voucher
nodes.description: Green/brown voucher with globe on stone pedestal. Planet Merchant — planet cards appear more frequently in the shop.

nodes.label: Antimatter Voucher
nodes.description: Purple voucher with a glowing crystal ball. Antimatter — upgraded Crystal Ball granting another extra consumable slot.

nodes.label: Petroglyph Voucher
nodes.description: Blue voucher with vial/liquid icon. Petroglyph — upgraded Hieroglyph, each Ante hand size increases further.

nodes.label: Illusion Voucher
nodes.description: Dark voucher with a top hat icon. Illusion — playing cards in the shop may have a random edition.

nodes.label: Oracle Voucher
nodes.description: Brown/wooden door voucher with an eye icon. Oracle — tarot cards appear more frequently in the shop.

nodes.label: Rag and Bone Shop Voucher
nodes.description: Red/orange voucher with a mobile phone icon. Rag and Bone Shop — each round a destroyed card turns into a random card.

nodes.label: Observatory Voucher
nodes.description: Teal voucher with upgraded circular arrows. Observatory — upgraded Telescope, planet cards give extra Xmult.

nodes.label: Astronomy Voucher
nodes.description: Green voucher with tree/nature theme. Astronomy — upgraded Planet Merchant, blue seals can appear on cards in the shop.

nodes.label: Palette Voucher
nodes.description: Purple/rainbow sparkle voucher. Palette — upgraded Illusion, you can use any background/joker.

nodes.label: Director's Cut Voucher
nodes.description: Blue starry night voucher with top hat. Director's Cut — upgraded Illusion, one free reroll per shop.

nodes.label: Tarot Merchant Voucher
nodes.description: Red/orange starry voucher. Tarot Merchant — upgraded Oracle, two tarot cards appear in the shop each round.

nodes.label: Recyclomancy Plus Voucher
nodes.description: Green circuit-themed voucher. Upgraded discard/recycle mechanic voucher.

nodes.label: Blank/Placeholder Voucher Slot 1
nodes.description: Light/white blank voucher card placeholder in row 1.

nodes.label: Blank/Placeholder Voucher Slot 2
nodes.description: Light blank voucher card placeholder in row 3.

nodes.label: Locked Voucher Placeholder
nodes.description: Gray padlock icon indicating a locked/unavailable voucher slot at the bottom-right corner.
